about: What each copied lab wallet does, written by Claude on 2026-11-11 from its full Polymarket history (probe wallets_all, walletcheck.py). Shown on the dashboard for w_* and wb_* tracks. Notes only, never used for trading.

wallets.0xa19cbababc312f9df185e49d7004c249ed1ade: Crypto price bettor: 'will Bitcoin/Ethereum reach or dip to $X by date' markets, at every price from 5c to 95c, and never sells early. Its big money came from a few cheap long-shot bets on Ethereum crashing. Its expensive favorite bets (70c+) actually lost money overall.
wallets.0x23d81ba9371e576015c1e562db09c689f56b02: Big-money politics bettor ($600 typical bet, up to $80,000): elections around the world, mostly close calls at 30-70c, held for days or weeks. Made about $1.2 million, mostly from a few elections (Lula in Brazil). It also lost big on World Cup games.
wallets.0x3a8aa345d5db7ec5138298c8c4f4540259be76: Fed interest-rate specialist with very deep pockets (single bets up to $1 million). Also trades crypto and news markets in and out within the hour. Almost all its profit came from one huge Fed bet (about $2 million). Copying it means copying very few, very lumpy wins.
wallets.0xdbf16bcffa41bd95faec2640daa2c95ab2bd86: Rare, huge bets ($2,300 typical, up to $600,000), mostly world news (Iran, Middle East) and big football matches. Wins and losses swing by hundreds of thousands. It buys a lot at 90c+, and it sells more often than it buys.
wallets.0xf1f9a438f2697381b4ac8eb283d6f4dd772d12: Busy all-rounder since 2024 with small bets (about $100): politics, 'will X say Y' markets, world news. It does best on favorites at 70-90c, and its cheap long shots lose. Steady, about $390,000 profit over 2+ years.
wallets.0x6575759174ad221bba9947bc3f18750ec769b1: Big political bettor ($1,000 typical, up to $180,000): elections in Brazil, Israel and the US, mostly cheap-to-mid prices (10-70c). It wins less than half its bets but the winners are large. It also lost big on Israeli election markets.
wallets.0x24c8cf69a0e0a17eee21f69d29752bfa32e823: Very busy, very big trader (20,000 trades, $27 million bought) in news and politics. Its trick: buying near-certain things at 99c+ and dirt-cheap long shots at 0.1c. Huge wins and huge losses that almost cancel out. Hard to copy: our 5-share copies can't mirror that.
wallets.0x83720820a8aa6c3f20ad71850e7a1a17d16c52: Sports whale: World Cup and big football matches at 30-70c, bets of $6,000 typical, up to $280,000. Never sells, holds to the end. Made about $2.5 million, but single games swing $500,000+ either way.
wallets.0x448861155279dbf833d041b963e3ac854599e3: Sports and politics bettor since 2024 ($500 typical bet), mostly close calls at 30-70c that end within a couple of days. It also buys a lot of near-sure 90c+ bets, and those earned most reliably. About $1.3 million profit over 2 years.
wallets.0xd218e474776403a330142299f7796e8ba32eb5: Looks like a bot: about 20,000 small buys ($20 typical) in one week, across almost every kind of market, mostly at 90c+. It almost never sells. Its history numbers look too good to trust (likely old positions counted strangely), so judge it only by our own copy results.
wallets.0x6139c42e48cf190e67a0a85d492413b499336b: News and world-events trader since 2024 (Iran, Middle East, US politics): $240 typical bet, often cheap 10-30c bets on something dramatic happening. Holds days to weeks. About $1.1 million profit. Its cheapest long shots (under 10c) lost money.
wallets.0x629bc4a1e53e1d475beb7ea3d388791e96dd99: Election specialist since 2023: presidential and parliamentary races around the world, mostly 10-70c, held for months. About $1.35 million profit. Its 90c+ favorites lost money; its cheap picks won.
wallets.0x6bab41a0dc40d6dd4c1a915b8c01969479fd12: All-rounder: news, politics, 'will X say Y', even weather, $500 typical bet. Lots of near-sure 90c+ buys, sells quickly (often within a day). About $1.8 million profit over 2 years, spread across many topics.
wallets.0xde7be6d489bce070a959e0cb813128ae659b5f: Big world-news bettor ($1,600 typical, up to $200,000): Iran deals, Russia/Ukraine ceasefires, Fed rates. Mostly buys 'yes, the deal happens' cheap and holds for weeks. Won big on peace deals, lost big on others. Very lumpy.
wallets.0x96489abcb9f583d6835c8ef95ffc923d05a868: Middle East war-and-peace bettor (US/Iran strikes, ceasefires). Big bets, held for weeks. LOST about $4.8 million overall: big losses betting 'No, the US won't strike Iran'. A warning example, not a model.
wallets.0xf0ca28d5b0141f0a8e7b251dea80fd881cb166: One-trick wallet: bets on which company is the world's biggest (Apple vs Nvidia), held for months. Made about $460,000, almost all from those few markets. Rarely trades anything else.
wallets.0xc851cd9bee7d262afd78674f861f9f576a12cd: News and politics bettor ($1,000 typical): Iran, Middle East, elections, sometimes 'will X say Y'. Its 70c+ favorites made the money; its cheap long shots lost. About $650,000 profit.
wallets.0xc3daa1bb9ce85866fb1a7c3a5d02816798e641: Central-bank specialist: bets that the Fed, ECB, Bank of Canada etc. will RAISE rates, usually cheap (10-40c), held for weeks. Small history (about 20 markets). One Fed bet made $235,000; most others lost.
wallets.0x62cf46cd4c3af254dccfc37a7f93de265b4b58: Politics and news bettor since 2024 ($190 typical): elections, Trump pardons, Ukraine. Mostly likely sides at 50-90c. About $340,000 profit, mostly from 70-90c favorites.
wallets.0x71edffd0d70a1da823ff07a3c6fc81457294d3: Fed interest-rate specialist who buys the likely outcome (70c-99c) and holds for weeks. Made its money on Fed decisions; lost on Middle East news bets.
wallets.0x134a63b764ac7b008356e8db1857db94e6b09e: Very busy since 2024 (9,700 trades), mostly 'will X say Y' markets and sports, mostly near-sure 90c+ buys. Wins a lot of small bets, but big sports losses ate most of it: only about $125,000 profit on $5.7 million bought.
wallets.0xbf93328f8b69273453228a82c913207731822f: Few, chunky bets ($2,000 typical) on news, AI model releases and politics, mostly 30-90c, held for days. About $118,000 profit, best on Middle East news.
wallets.0x3c593aeb73ebdadbc9ce76d4264a6a2af40117: News bettor (Iran deals, Epstein files, government shutdowns), mostly close calls at 30-70c, holds for days. About $310,000 profit, mostly from US/Iran peace-deal bets.
wallets.0xe2b1fc269d0c2e27da11fadd1d9596fe28227d: Busy since 2023: Fed rates, oil prices, elections, mostly 30-70c. Barely ahead (about $165,000 on $2.3 million bought). Its money came from cheap long shots; its mid-price bets lost.
wallets.0x3c918a8ef8c379304f744592120cbb4d76149a: Mostly Fed interest-rate markets, buying the likely outcome at 70-99c and holding for days. Wins about 3 of 4. About $360,000 profit. Stopped trading early November.
wallets.0x777fae71d2ff9ec48a1213d48ba1d9d91024a1: Very busy small bettor since 2023 ($40 typical): stock and commodity price targets, crypto, politics. Many tiny bets, about $280,000 profit over 3 years.
wallets.0x9e88f359b9803e41420fbb13385c5ae1765c30: Small bettor ($70 typical): European elections, company earnings ('will X beat earnings'), 'will X say Y'. Trades in and out a lot. About $106,000 profit over a year.
wallets.0x9aeb534c42b58b21673d5e03e9da14fbd15b27: Busy all-rounder ($180 typical): news, NFL games, esports, politics, often in and out within a day. Lots of 90c+ buys. About $166,000 profit; it lost on esports.
wallets.0xd86d87914387111b47355e87aca7c032dbe564: Politics and elections bettor, mostly likely sides at 70c+, sometimes holding a big 2028 election bet. About $68,000 profit, mostly from elections.
wallets.0xb22682e5efaaa5ae3f48c3b727cf78ae57c041: Weather bot: thousands of tiny bets ($12 typical) on daily temperature markets, mostly at 50-90c, held 1-3 days. Wins 3 of 4 but only about break-even overall ($2,800 profit). Copying it at 5 shares is mostly fees and noise.
wallets.0x1076773fc4639a7ad88bcfa5dbfee1dd3aa7c0: Weather bot, started late October: only daily temperature markets, $60 typical bet, mostly 30-70c, over within a day. Barely ahead (about $5,000 on $110,000 bought).
wallets.0x5415c298dde8c84f4ba726d36b411df6e9a72a: 'Will X say Y' specialist: Trump speeches, sports announcers, YouTube view counts. Small bets ($35 typical), quick in and out. About $42,000 profit, almost all from word markets.
wallets.0x852a61deac7872fff2c6a80ee82c059d6a8d31: 'Will X say Y' specialist, mostly buying the near-sure side at 90c+ in Trump speech markets, small bets ($25 typical). About $46,000 profit over 2 years.
wallets.0x71abe97b83eaba3f06cb04fd4d9a03ee37d2f0: Middle East shipping bettor: 'will the Strait of Hormuz reopen' and Iran blockade markets, mostly betting No, held for weeks. About $175,000 profit, nearly all from Hormuz markets.
wallets.0xc4086b708cd3a50880b7069add1a1a80000f46: All-rounder since 2024: mostly near-sure 90c+ buys in politics and news, plus occasional cheap long shots that hit (a 3c Irish election win). About $390,000 profit.
wallets.0x10a6fadcbacd66330862206f6199b197e3ad4d: Football whale: World Cup and international games (who wins, draws, over/under goals) at about 50c, $100 typical but up to $260,000 a game. Never sells. Wins about half: break-even-ish on $19 million bought.
wallets.0x511f9c771449162349795d17becf8b37031acb: Looks like a bot: 20,000 trades in 3 months across everything, mostly 90c+ and under-10c bets, held to the end. Says $3.3 million profit, but thousands of open positions are worth nearly nothing, so treat that with suspicion.
wallets.0x1f5f9fa318fbda8350ac143b4df657287df850: Busy small bettor ($30 typical) on US elections and the Fed: many cheap 'No' and long-shot bets, loses most of them but wins a few big ones. About $415,000 profit in 2 months.
wallets.0x94c4fe3b18435aa92024c7c1589537fcda3f43: Election bettor: US Senate races, German state elections, even Eurovision, mostly cheap 10-30c picks that sometimes hit big. About $540,000 profit. Last trade early November.
wallets.0x7ea7bcd658a253bfa78618a8e127cc73b54879: Slow bettor since 2024: US politics and Iran news, mostly 30-90c, holds for months. Roughly break-even: $520,000 won, $490,000 lost.
